      "grounding": [{"end_line":1162,"quote":"Every Product path claim requires two-sided evidence:\n\n1. **required-path reachability**: each required authoritative composition has\n   an exact witness in the deployed, installed, or otherwise runnable Product\n   form through the supported ordinary path; and\n2. **forbidden-path exclusion**: each material superseded, duplicate, fallback,\n   bypass, or otherwise forbidden production path is absent, unreachable, or\n   refused at its declared boundary.","section_id":"repo://stdo-v3-generation-rc9/codex/5592168e26759f37e730aed12c030a6061709ec4/source/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#STDO%20Reference%20Frame%20Baseline%2FDerived%20Product%20Testing%20Frame%20Set%2FLegitimate-Path%20And%20Technical-Debt%20Erasure","start_line":1155}],
      "key": "two_sided_path_evidence",
      "statement": "Require an exact ordinary-path runnable witness for every required authoritative composition and absence, unreachability or declared-boundary refusal for every material superseded, duplicate, fallback, bypass or otherwise forbidden production path. Production closure includes exact configuration, transitive imports/exports, package paths, switches, registries, fallbacks, consumers, generated runtime artifacts, recovery and fresh-process reconstruction; no obsolete, bypass, fallback or rival production path may remain reachable in the claimed scope. Assurance/source closure includes relied-on consumers, fixtures, proof scripts, generators, mutations and tooling; obsolete assurance consumers must neither falsely supply closure evidence nor reintroduce a removed path. Retained obsolete tests/proof consumers with either capability remain assurance defects. Success through a forbidden path falsifies the path claim rather than passing the Product test; successor success does not prove predecessor removal.",

      "grounding": [{"end_line":1199,"quote":"A negative-path test that mutates the exact subject\nwithout isolation, restoration, and subject revalidation invalidates its own\nassurance basis.","section_id":"repo://stdo-v3-generation-rc9/codex/5592168e26759f37e730aed12c030a6061709ec4/source/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#STDO%20Reference%20Frame%20Baseline%2FDerived%20Product%20Testing%20Frame%20Set%2FLegitimate-Path%20And%20Technical-Debt%20Erasure","start_line":1197}],
      "key": "path_mutation_assurance",
